A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same KANO research and provide readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Appendices A–E correspond across versions; v6 adds Appendix F. No material comparison gaps were found.

before.justification: v4 reports original synthetic-operator experiments and double-well/NLSE quantum-dynamics simulations, including losses, state infidelities, and recovered symbolic coefficients in Tables 1–4.

after.justification: v6 retains these original experiments and simulation outcomes in Section 5 and Tables 1–4, supported by the data-generation and experimental descriptions in Appendix B.

M1.justification: The KANO architecture, KAN symbol and activation subnetworks, Kohn–Nirenberg quantization, symbolic recovery procedure, and Q-KANO adaptation remain unchanged, including Equations 14–19.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same three synthetic operators using the same Group A/B function families and interpolation scenarios. The double-well and NLSE tasks, initial-state families, and quantum supervision scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains FNO, U-FNO, AM-FNO, PDNO, and the same KANO variants. Table 3 retains the same FNO and Q-KANO comparison rows and supervision types. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B retain the sample counts, preprocessing, model configurations, losses, and testing procedures. These include the 128-point grids, 100-step interpolation, and quantum evaluation using 10 training steps followed by 90 additional steps.

E4.justification: The KAN-to-MLP ablations, function-family generalization and interpolation tests, linear-versus-cubic symbolic check, and quantum supervision comparisons already appear in v4 and are retained in v6.

E5.justification: Neither version introduces training-seed counts, repeated-training uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Appendix B’s sample-randomization and ideal repeatable-shot descriptions are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 retain their numerical results, parameter counts, and recovered coefficients. For example, Q-KANO with position-and-momentum supervision retains state infidelities of 6.3×10^-6 for double-well and 5.6×10^-6 for NLSE. All six figure images are unchanged after matching their relocation and renumbering.

T1.justification: The definitions, Lemma 1, Theorems 1–2, Corollary 1, Proposition 1, and mathematical arguments in Appendices C–E retain the same substance. Changes to theorem-restatement wording and equation-reference formatting do not revise the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims about FNO’s spectral bottleneck, KANO’s dual-domain expressivity and generalization, symbolic recovery, and parameter efficiency. The new publication statements introduce no scientific contribution claim.

C2.justification: The architectural explanation for generalization, quantum-observability interpretation, and qualifications concerning high-dimensional applications and computational costs remain unchanged in Remark 3, Section 5.2, and Appendices D–E.

D1.justification: v6 adds a reproducibility statement linking a repository and stating that code, configurations, dataset artifacts, and rerun instructions are available. v4 has experimental details but no equivalent access pointer. Appendix B’s technical settings are unchanged; repository contents cannot be verified from the PDFs.

R1.justification: The cited works and bibliography are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to FNO variants, PDNO, DeepOKAN, and earlier KAN research. Appendix F’s disclosure about reference-search assistance adds no cited work or revised research positioning.

P1.justification: v6 adds reproducibility and ethics statements, acknowledgments, and Appendix F on LLM use. It also updates the publication header and author contact information and makes scattered grammar, typo, and cross-reference edits. The scientific narrative and section organization remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: Existing displays are rearranged: Table 1 moves from page 8 to page 7, and v4’s quantum Figures 5 and 6 become v6’s Figures 6 and 5. Other floats and surrounding text reflow, alongside title-page formatting changes. Figure artwork and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v6 provides a concrete reproduction-access pointer absent from v4 and adds transparency through its LLM-use disclosure, alongside limited editorial corrections. This improves documentation modestly. The scientific evidence and arguments remain unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish whether the advertised repository materials actually enable reproduction.
